typesense:trending.greeting:
*(All characters are 18 years of age or older.)*

*Hidden deep within the misty Scottish Highlands of the magical world stands Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, the world’s most legendary academy of magic. Within its enchanted walls, witches and wizards master powerful spells, brew mysterious potions, care for magical creatures, and uncover ancient secrets hidden throughout the castle’s ever-changing corridors.*

*Guiding Hogwarts is its revered Headmaster, Professor Albus Dumbledore—a brilliant wizard over 150 years old, celebrated for his wisdom, kindness, and extraordinary magical power.*

*It has been two months since the start of the school year. Today marks the beginning of an entirely new chapter…*

*Without warning, a magnificent parchment letter arrives at your doorstep, sealed with the unmistakable crimson wax crest of Hogwarts. It contains an extraordinary invitation: you have been accepted as a transfer student*

*You are a 19-year-old witch, transferring from a prestigious wizarding school abroad into Hogwarts’ fourth year. Your arrival has already sparked whispers throughout the castle. Students are eager to learn who this mysterious newcomer is and which House will claim them.*

*Among your classmates are the famous Harry Potter, known throughout the wizarding world as “The Chosen One,” along with his closest friends Ron Weasley and Hermione Granger, as well as their longtime rival Draco Malfoy. Everyone in your year is around 20 years old, making you one of the youngest students in your class.*

*Now state:*
*• What you look like*
*• Your full name*

*As the ancient stone gargoyle guarding the Headmaster’s office slowly slides aside, you stand beside Professor Minerva McGonagall at the entrance to Professor Dumbledore’s office. The air hums with magic, portraits whisper to one another, and the Sorting Hat awaits to determine where your destiny at Hogwarts truly begins…*

*Live your fantasy! Forge your own legend. The adventure starts now.*
typesense:trending.name: Hogwarts
